# Paper artifact map — every figure and table, and where it came from

**GENERATED by `scripts/mk_artifact_map.py`. Do not hand-edit.**
Which document includes which figure, which tables each document
inputs, and every hash below are read from the sources at generation
time. Run `python3 scripts/mk_artifact_map.py --check` to detect drift.

Back to [the project README](../README.md) · [manuscript package](../paper/README.md) · [current handoff](../HANDOFF_CURRENT.md)

Design rationale for individual figures and tables — why this encoding,
why no error bars, why one actor — lives in
[`paper/figures/README.md`](../paper/figures/README.md) and
[`paper/tables/README.md`](../paper/tables/README.md). This file is the
cross-cutting provenance chain; those are the design records.

## The chain every number travels

```
experiments/results/FROZEN/            Omni-MATH, 11,600 rows, sha256-manifested
experiments/results/xdomain/FROZEN_SCIBENCH/   SciBench, 2,296 rows
        |
        v
analysis/scripts/FINAL_TABLES.py       the ONLY source of a number
        |-> analysis/out/FINAL_TABLES_OUTPUT.txt   (tables parse this)
        `-> analysis/out/FIGDATA.json              (figures read this)
        |
        +-> analysis/scripts/mk_tables.py  -> paper/tables/*.tex
        `-> analysis/scripts/mk_fig*.py    -> figures/ -> paper/figures/
```

No figure or table contains a hand-typed number. A value that cannot be
produced by running `FINAL_TABLES.py` against the frozen snapshot is not
a value this project reports.

| **2** (main paper) | The same dissociation in a second, free-response science domain | `paper/figures/fig2_v2_xdomain.pdf`<br>sha256 `4525bb027304…` | `analysis/scripts/mk_fig2_xdomain.py` | `analysis/out/FIGDATA.json` | `experiments/results/FROZEN/` + `…/FROZEN_SCIBENCH/` | trajectory; bottom row counts PROBLEMS first-pass-wrong under both conditions | top row marginal, bottom row paired -- labelled in the figure | canonical |

**Both figures draw from the same `FIGDATA.json`**, so they cannot disagree about a shared quantity. Figure 1B and Figure 2's Omni-MATH column show the *same cell* in different populations (marginal vs paired); each figure says which. They are different numbers and not a contradiction.

**Current `n` for every table is printed in the table itself**, per cell, with its denominator named. This file deliberately does not restate those counts: a count copied here would be a second copy of a number, which is the defect `SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md` exists to prevent.

### The one table whose data is not ours

`single_agent_comparison.tex` reads a **previously released trace corpus that lives outside this repository** (`[T17] … NOT IN THE FROZEN SNAPSHOT` in the canonical output names the path and hashes the file). Two consequences, both stated in the paper: its two actor arms were built from *different source commits*, so each within-actor direction is a sound guard and the **gap between actors is not**; and if that sibling project moves, `FINAL_TABLES.py` prints `UNAVAILABLE:` for T17 rather than silently dropping it.

| GitHub HEAD then | `e4a644b5cd05` |
| main paper | 9 pages, main text ends p8 |
| supplement | 11 pages, no limit |
| main text sha256 | `91741620602076cc7bec603e…` |
| supplement text sha256 | `c71100f5da0f6182afa3868c…` |
| all gates | **PASS** |

Text hashes, not byte hashes: pdflatex embeds a wall-clock timestamp, so a PDF's byte hash identifies a *build*. `pdftotext x.pdf - | shasum -a 256` reproduces the values above.

## Regenerating any of it

```bash
python3 analysis/scripts/FINAL_TABLES.py > analysis/out/FINAL_TABLES_OUTPUT.txt
python3 analysis/scripts/mk_tables.py        # -> paper/tables/*.tex
python3 analysis/scripts/mk_fig1_story.py    # -> figures/ and paper/figures/
python3 analysis/scripts/mk_fig2_xdomain.py
python3 scripts/mk_artifact_map.py           # -> this file
python3 scripts/final_freeze.py              # every gate, both documents
```

The figure generators now copy into `paper/figures/` themselves. Figure PDFs are byte-reproducible (the wall-clock `CreationDate` is stripped), so a changed figure hash means changed *data*.

## Gaps

None. Every figure the documents include has a declared purpose, every generated table is inputted by a document, and no file in `paper/figures/` is unreferenced.
